qe: Passage: On Saturday, Nila visited a small museum with her class. The guide showed them a brass compass once used by sailors. Nila noticed that it pointed north even when she turned it. The guide explained that Earth has a magnetic field. Before leaving, each student sketched one object. Nila chose the compass because it connected science with travel. Where did Nila go with her class?
qh: गद्यांश: शनिवार को नीला अपनी कक्षा के साथ एक छोटे संग्रहालय गई। मार्गदर्शक ने उन्हें नाविकों द्वारा पहले उपयोग किया गया पीतल का कंपास दिखाया। नीला ने देखा कि घुमाने पर भी वह उत्तर दिशा बताता था। मार्गदर्शक ने पृथ्वी के चुंबकीय क्षेत्र के बारे में बताया। जाने से पहले प्रत्येक विद्यार्थी ने एक वस्तु का चित्र बनाया। नीला ने कंपास चुना क्योंकि वह विज्ञान को यात्रा से जोड़ता था। नीला अपनी कक्षा के साथ कहाँ गई?
e: The passage says Nila visited a small museum with her class.

qe: Passage: On Saturday, Nila visited a small museum with her class. The guide showed them a brass compass once used by sailors. Nila noticed that it pointed north even when she turned it. The guide explained that Earth has a magnetic field. Before leaving, each student sketched one object. Nila chose the compass because it connected science with travel. What was the compass made of?
qh: गद्यांश: शनिवार को नीला अपनी कक्षा के साथ एक छोटे संग्रहालय गई। मार्गदर्शक ने उन्हें नाविकों द्वारा पहले उपयोग किया गया पीतल का कंपास दिखाया। नीला ने देखा कि घुमाने पर भी वह उत्तर दिशा बताता था। मार्गदर्शक ने पृथ्वी के चुंबकीय क्षेत्र के बारे में बताया। जाने से पहले प्रत्येक विद्यार्थी ने एक वस्तु का चित्र बनाया। नीला ने कंपास चुना क्योंकि वह विज्ञान को यात्रा से जोड़ता था। कंपास किस धातु का बना था?
e: The guide showed the class a brass compass.

qe: Passage: On Saturday, Nila visited a small museum with her class. The guide showed them a brass compass once used by sailors. Nila noticed that it pointed north even when she turned it. The guide explained that Earth has a magnetic field. Before leaving, each student sketched one object. Nila chose the compass because it connected science with travel. Which direction did the compass point?

oh: वह किसी दिशा का संकेत नहीं करता था
e: Nila noticed that the compass pointed north, even when she turned it.

The guide explained that Earth has a magnetic field. Before leaving, each student sketched one object. Nila chose the compass because it connected science with travel. What did the guide explain about Earth?
qh: गद्यांश: शनिवार को नीला अपनी कक्षा के साथ एक छोटे संग्रहालय गई। मार्गदर्शक ने उन्हें नाविकों द्वारा पहले उपयोग किया गया पीतल का कंपास दिखाया। नीला ने देखा कि घुमाने पर भी वह उत्तर दिशा बताता था। मार्गदर्शक ने पृथ्वी के चुंबकीय क्षेत्र के बारे में बताया। जाने से पहले प्रत्येक विद्यार्थी ने एक वस्तु का चित्र बनाया। नीला ने कंपास चुना क्योंकि वह विज्ञान को यात्रा से जोड़ता था। मार्गदर्शक ने पृथ्वी के बारे में क्या समझाया?
e: The guide explained that Earth has a magnetic field.

qe: Passage: On Saturday, Nila visited a small museum with her class. The guide showed them a brass compass once used by sailors. Nila noticed that it pointed north even when she turned it. The guide explained that Earth has a magnetic field. Before leaving, each student sketched one object. Nila chose the compass because it connected science with travel. Why did Nila choose the compass to sketch?
qh: गद्यांश: शनिवार को नीला अपनी कक्षा के साथ एक छोटे संग्रहालय गई। मार्गदर्शक ने उन्हें नाविकों द्वारा पहले उपयोग किया गया पीतल का कंपास दिखाया। नीला ने देखा कि घुमाने पर भी वह उत्तर दिशा बताता था। मार्गदर्शक ने पृथ्वी के चुंबकीय क्षेत्र के बारे में बताया। जाने से पहले प्रत्येक विद्यार्थी ने एक वस्तु का चित्र बनाया। नीला ने कंपास चुना क्योंकि वह विज्ञान को यात्रा से जोड़ता था। नीला ने चित्र बनाने के लिए कंपास क्यों चुना?
oe: It joined her interests in science and travel
The guide told her to take it home
oh: यह विज्ञान और यात्रा में उसकी रुचि को जोड़ता था
मार्गदर्शक ने उसे घर ले जाने को कहा
e: Nila chose it because it connected science with travel.

qe: Who wrote the novel 'Pride and Prejudice'?
qh: उपन्यास 'Pride and Prejudice' किसने लिखा?
e: Jane Austen wrote 'Pride and Prejudice'.

qe: Who wrote the poem 'Ode to a Nightingale'?
qh: कविता 'Ode to a Nightingale' किसने लिखी?
e: 'Ode to a Nightingale' is a famous poem by John Keats.

qe: Who is the author of 'The Merchant of Venice'?
qh: 'The Merchant of Venice' के लेखक कौन हैं?
e: William Shakespeare wrote the play 'The Merchant of Venice'.

qe: Who wrote 'Gulliver's Travels'?
qh: 'Gulliver's Travels' किसने लिखा?
e: 'Gulliver's Travels' is a work by Jonathan Swift.

qe: Which figure of speech is used in 'She is as brave as a lion'?
qh: 'She is as brave as a lion' में कौन-सा figure of speech है?
e: A comparison using 'as...as' is a simile.

qe: Which figure of speech appears in 'Time is a thief'?
qh: 'Time is a thief' में कौन-सा figure of speech है?
e: The sentence directly describes time as a thief, making an implied comparison called a metaphor.

qe: Which sound device is repeated in 'Wild winds whispered'?
qh: 'Wild winds whispered' में किस ध्वनि-अलंकार की पुनरावृत्ति है?
e: The repeated initial w sound is alliteration.

qe: Which figure of speech is used in 'The classroom was a zoo'?
qh: 'The classroom was a zoo' में कौन-सा figure of speech है?
e: The classroom is directly compared to a zoo without 'like' or 'as', so it is a metaphor.

qe: Choose the antonym of 'abundant'.
qh: 'Abundant' का विलोम शब्द चुनिए।
e: 'Scarce' means limited or not plentiful, the opposite of 'abundant'.

qe: Choose a synonym of 'reluctant'.
qh: 'Reluctant' का समानार्थी शब्द चुनिए।
e: A reluctant person is unwilling or hesitant to do something.

qe: Which part of speech replaces a noun?
qh: संज्ञा के स्थान पर आने वाला शब्द-भेद कौन-सा है?
e: A pronoun is used in place of a noun.

qe: Which word is the adjective in 'The beautiful painting won a prize'?
qh: 'The beautiful painting won a prize' में adjective कौन-सा शब्द है?
e: 'Beautiful' describes the painting, so it is an adjective.

qe: Which word is the verb in 'Birds migrate south in winter'?
qh: 'Birds migrate south in winter' में verb कौन-सा शब्द है?
e: 'Migrate' expresses the action performed by the birds.

qe: Which word is the adverb in 'She spoke softly'?
qh: 'She spoke softly' में adverb कौन-सा शब्द है?
e: 'Softly' tells how she spoke, so it is an adverb.

qe: Choose the correct passive form of 'The child broke the glass.'
qh: 'The child broke the glass.' का सही passive रूप चुनिए।
oe: The glass was broken by the child.
The child was broken by the glass.
The glass is break by the child.
The child has broke the glass.
oh: The glass was broken by the child.
The child was broken by the glass.
The glass is break by the child.
The child has broke the glass.
e: In the simple past passive, the object becomes the subject and the verb takes 'was broken'.

qe: Choose the correct reported speech: He said, 'I am busy.'
qh: सही reported speech चुनिए: He said, 'I am busy.'
oe: He said that he was busy.
He said that I am busy.
He said that he is busy yesterday.
oh: He said that he was busy.
He said that I am busy.
He said that he is busy yesterday.
e: In reported speech after 'said', 'I' changes to 'he' and 'am' usually backshifts to 'was'.

qe: Choose the correct article: It took us ___ hour to reach the fort.
qh: सही article चुनिए: It took us ___ hour to reach the fort.
e: The h in 'hour' is silent, so use 'an'.

qe: Neither of the answers ___ correct.
qh: Neither of the answers ___ correct.
e: 'Neither' is singular in standard formal agreement, so it takes 'is'.

qe: Choose the correct preposition: Mira is fond ___ classical music.
qh: सही preposition चुनिए: Mira is fond ___ classical music.
e: The standard collocation is 'fond of'.

qe: Choose the grammatically correct sentence.
qh: व्याकरण की दृष्टि से सही वाक्य चुनिए।
oe: Despite being tired, she finished her work.
Despite she was tired, she finished her work.
Despite of being tired, she finished her work.
Despite tired, she finished her work.
Despite she tired, she finished work.
oh: Despite being tired, she finished her work.
Despite she was tired, she finished her work.
Despite of being tired, she finished her work.
Despite tired, she finished her work.
Despite she tired, she finished work.
e: 'Despite' is followed by a noun or gerund phrase, not a full clause introduced by 'she'.

qe: Choose the correctly spelt word.
qh: सही वर्तनी वाला शब्द चुनिए।
e: The correct spelling is 'separate'.

qe: Which word is an abstract noun?
qh: इनमें से कौन-सा abstract noun है?
e: 'Wisdom' names a quality or idea, so it is an abstract noun.

qe: Which suffix forms a noun meaning 'a person who teaches' from 'teach'?
qh: 'Teach' से 'पढ़ाने वाला व्यक्ति' अर्थ का noun बनाने वाला suffix कौन-सा है?
e: Adding '-er' to 'teach' forms 'teacher', a person who teaches.

qe: Complete the sentence: If I ___ more time, I would read another chapter.
qh: वाक्य पूरा कीजिए: If I ___ more time, I would read another chapter.
e: This second conditional uses the past form 'had' in the if-clause.

qe: What is a poem of fourteen lines, often written in a set rhyme pattern, called?
qh: सामान्यतः निश्चित तुक-योजना में लिखी चौदह पंक्तियों की कविता को क्या कहते हैं?
e: A sonnet is a fourteen-line poem, traditionally with a structured rhyme scheme.
